parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotence. This value must be unique for each request. **ClientToken** must contain only ASCII characters and be no longer than 64 characters.

parameters.name: OssBucketName
parameters.description: The name of the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

parameters.name: OssRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the OSS bucket. For more information, see [OSS regions and endpoints](~~31837~~).
